## `/fundadmin:fund review-lpa <file>` {#review-lpa}

Full LPA review (5 dependency-ordered agents)

Runs the 5-agent LPA pipeline (terms, risks, compliance, obligations, recommendations) into methodology v2 heuristic document favourability, or an explicit unavailable result. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund review-lpa`, asks to review fund terms, or shares an LPA.

## `/fundadmin:fund review-ppm <file>` {#review-ppm}

PPM/offering document review

Reviews a PPM or offering memorandum for risk factor completeness, fee disclosure clarity, stated regulatory status (Reg D, 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7), ERISA) and LPA consistency, as counts. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund review-ppm`, asks to review offering documents, or shares a PPM.

## `/fundadmin:fund review-side-letter <file>` {#review-side-letter}

Side letter obligation extraction

Builds an obligation inventory from a side letter, categorizes every right, rates MFN cascade risk, and flags LPA and cross-side-letter conflicts. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund review-side-letter`, asks about MFN exposure, or shares a side letter. Writes `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md` with an investor pseudonym.

## `/fundadmin:fund review-k1 <file>` {#review-k1}
